description: Department of Local Government, North Western Province - Amended Gazette Extra No. 2238/35 dated 30 July 2021 by Virtue of Powders rested under Section 24 of Pradeshiya Sabha Act, No. 15 of 1987
reasoning: This gazette notification amends the Pradeshiya Sabha Act (No. 15 of 1987) by extending time periods for local government bodies to take action under Section 24 of the Act. It involves legal amendments and regulatory changes to existing legislation, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). While it mentions the Governor by name, this is in an official capacity to establish authority for the legal amendment, not to announce a personnel change or assign detailed portfolio responsibilities.
